title: 推理导致多样性崩溃：LLM在博弈中的行为趋同现象
summary: 研究发现监督微调（SFT）会降低大语言模型在序列决策中的行为多样性，尤其在推理模式下，动作多样性显著下降而准确性并未同步提升。标准SFT导致过早的多样性崩溃，而动作增强（训练所有最优动作而非单一示范）可部分缓解此问题。
summary_en: Supervised fine-tuning reduces behavioral diversity in LLM sequential decision-making, especially in reasoning mode where action diversity collapses without accuracy improvement. Standard SFT induces premature diversity collapse; action augmentation (training on all optimal actions) partially mitigates this.
